title: Analytic: doped silicon in a PEC guide, Soref-Bennett n_eff and loss vs hole density (em_modes)
description:
Cross-section modes (em_modes, mode_analysis at 1.55 um) of a PEC rectangle of 52 x 27 uniform 20 nm cells (wall planes on the inner faces of the outermost cells: a = 1.0 um, b = 0.5 um) filled with silicon whose eps_r / sigma_e follow the Soref-Bennett plasma dispersion (1.55 um fit, N, P in cm^-3: dn = -(8.8e-22 N + 8.5e-18 P^0.8), alpha = 8.5e-18 N + 6.0e-18 P [1/cm]; eps_r = (n0 + dn)^2, sigma_e = n alpha eps0 c) with N_e = 1e18 cm^-3 and the hole density N_h swept 1e23..1e25 m^-3.
Analytic (homogeneous complex fill, discrete TE10): n_eff^2 = A - j B with A = eps_r - (K / k0)^2, K = (2 / h) sin(pi h / (2 a)), B = n alpha / k0; Re n_eff = sqrt((hypot(A, B) + A) / 2), Im n_eff = -B / (2 Re n_eff); loss = -(20 / ln 10) k0 Im n_eff / 100 dB/cm (the material alpha times n / Re n_eff, in dB/cm).
Sweep tab: n_eff_1, n_eff_imag_1 and loss_1 (mode table row 0) vs N_h with their dashed references (the hole term's 0.8 power bends n_eff; the loss is linear in N_h).
Line profile tab: sz_profile = S_z of the 1 W mode across x at mid-height, 2 / (a b) sin^2(pi (x - h) / a) (W/m^2; TE10 power flow, independent of the fill).
Expected: n_eff ~1e-6, n_eff_imag / loss ~1e-5 (float32 eps_r / sigma_e and the eigen-solve), sz ~1e-4 (if the mode is normalised to +1 W).
